embeds.title: 🟡 Microsoft Warns of New Defender Zero-Days Exploited in Attacks
embeds.description:
Microsoft released security patches for two Defender vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-41091 and CVE-2026-45498) that have been exploited in zero-day attacks. CVE-2026-41091 is a privilege escalation flaw in Microsoft Malware Protection Engine affecting versions 1.1.26030.3008 and earlier, allowing attackers to gain SYSTEM privileges through improper link resolution. CVE-2026-45498 affects Microsoft Defender Antimalware Platform 4.18.26030.3011 and earlier, enabling threat actors to trigger denial-of-service states on unpatched Windows devices. CISA has ordered Federal Civilian Executive Branch agencies to secure their Windows systems against these vulnerabilities within two weeks by June 3.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-41091, CVE-2026-45498 • **Access:** n/a
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** reported
